# Habitinator

> Cross-platform habits, dailies, and to-dos with focus timer and statistics.

Habitinator is a Blazor web and .NET MAUI productivity app. User board data is private and requires authentication. This file describes public surfaces only.

## Product

- [Live app](https://habitinator.app/)
- [Source](https://github.com/kadato/Habitinator)
- [README](https://github.com/kadato/Habitinator#readme)

## Public pages

- `/` shows the landing page. Signed-out visitors sign in, register, or continue as the demo guest.
- `/auth/login` shows the sign-in form.
- `/auth/register` shows the registration form.
- `/privacy` states the cookie and data policy. The app uses essential cookies only.

## API, authenticated

- [OpenAPI](https://habitinator.app/openapi/v1.json)
- [API catalog](https://habitinator.app/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [Board REST API](/api/board) accepts JWT or cookie auth
- [Health](https://habitinator.app/health)

## Privacy

Authentication uses session cookies and optional JWT for native clients. The web app contains no third-party advertising trackers. Read [the privacy policy](https://habitinator.app/privacy).

## Security

To report a vulnerability, read [security.txt](https://habitinator.app/.well-known/security.txt).
